package: @astryxdesign/cli

## Install

Astryx requires React 19 or later: `react` and `react-dom` >= 19.0.0 are peer dependencies of `@astryxdesign/core`.

Add the core package and its `@stylexjs/stylex` peer dependency, plus a theme and the CLI.

Terminal:
```bash
npm install @astryxdesign/core @stylexjs/stylex @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @astryxdesign/cli
```

Then run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init` to install the AI agent cheat sheet (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md). It's non-interactive; no prompts; so it's safe for AI agents, CI, and scripts. Add `--all` for pointers to the theme and page-building workflows.

Terminal:
```bash
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init
```
